activity.notes: Brazil's presidential archive records João Goulart's effective presidency from 8 September 1961 to 1 April 1964, spanning an initial parliamentary phase and a later presidential phase. ATLAS records the constitutional presidency as one office term rather than splitting the system-of-government change into separate presidencies.

sources.title: João Belchior Marques Goulart — Biblioteca da Presidência
sources.citation_text: Brazil's presidential archive gives Goulart's effective presidency as 8 September 1961 to 1 April 1964 and distinguishes parliamentary and presidential phases within the same presidency.

sources.title: Dados ex-Presidente — João Goulart
sources.citation_text: The Brazilian federal government confirms Goulart's presidency and the parliamentary and presidential phases of his administration.
